goal: Create a local field-map decision for Customer, Vendor and Item/Service data so future UI, Excel-assisted or configuration-package routes cannot hide Foundation setup gaps.
whyNow: MASTER-DATA-WRITE-GATE-PREP classified Master Data writes as not ready for direct creation. A realistic customer project needs a field map before any future write-gate or load route.
businessPurpose: Turn observed Universaarl Master Data context into a reusable customer-project data map with explicit blocked fields, validation needs and route candidates.
expectedOutput: A compact local result JSON or Markdown field map for Customer, Vendor and Item/Service route candidates.
Explicit classification of fields as ready-for-future-gate, source-needed, blocked, training-only or parked.
A nextCase selection that still does not create or edit Business Central data.
stopConditions: Stop if the field map would be treated as import or write permission.
Stop if a Foundation setup gap is hidden instead of explicitly blocking a field.
Stop if the case requires Business Central or Playwright live execution.
Stop if the result claims Master Data, O2C, P2P, Inventory, Preview Posting or Posting readiness.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use only if the field map narrows the scope to safe non-posting customer fields and keeps posting/VAT/payment dependencies blocked.
Use if the field map needs another read-first UI validation of templates, mandatory markers or list/card fields before a write gate.
Use if field mapping shows too many Master Data fields are blocked by Foundation setup gaps.
